content.text: {"actor":"AMF","condition":"If the AMF indicates active time value to the UE","normative_type":"discouragement","polarity":"negative","action":"indicate \"all PLMN registration area allocated\" indication in the MICO indication IE to the UE","exception":""}

{"explanation_ko":"AMF가 UE에 active time value를 알리는 경우, AMF는 UE에 대한 MICO indication IE에서 \"all PLMN registration area allocated\" 표시를 알리지 않는 것이 권고된다.","normative_type":"discouragement","actor":"AMF","condition":"AMF가 UE에 active time value를 알리는 경우","action":"UE에 대한 MICO indication IE에서 \"all PLMN registration area allocated\" 표시를 알리는 것","exception":"","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 24.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"5.3.6"}

{"actor":"Each N3IWF, TNGF, TWIF and W-AGF","condition":"","normative_type":"permission","polarity":"positive","action":"be configured with a different TAI value or with the same TAI value as other N3IWFs, TNGFs, TWIFs and/or W-AGFs","exception":""}

{"explanation_ko":"각 N3IWF, TNGF, TWIF 및 W-AGF는 다른 TAI 값으로 구성되도록 허용되며, 다른 N3IWFs, TNGFs, TWIFs 및/또는 W-AGFs와 동일한 TAI 값으로 구성되도록도 허용된다.","normative_type":"permission","actor":"Each N3IWF, TNGF, TWIF and W-AGF","condition":"","action":"be configured with a different TAI value or with the same TAI value as other N3IWFs, TNGFs, TWIFs and/or W-AGFs","exception":"","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 23.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"5.3.2.3"}

{"actor":"the target AMF","condition":"When a new 5G NAS security context is derived using the same K AMF","normative_type":"obligation","polarity":"positive","action":"includes the 8 least significant bits of the downlink NAS COUNT in the Intra N1 mode NAS transparent container IE, and indicates that a new KAMF shall not be derived","exception":"see subclause 9.11.2.6"}

{"explanation_ko":"동일한 K_AMF로 새 5G NAS security context를 유도할 때, target AMF는 Intra N1 mode NAS transparent container IE에 downlink NAS COUNT의 하위 8비트를 포함하고, 새 KAMF를 유도해서는 안 된다고 표시해야 한다. (9.11.2.6 참조)","normative_type":"obligation","actor":"the target AMF","condition":"When a new 5G NAS security context is derived using the same K AMF","action":"includes the 8 least significant bits of the downlink NAS COUNT in the Intra N1 mode NAS transparent container IE, and indicates that a new KAMF shall not be derived","exception":"see subclause 9.11.2.6","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 24.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"4.4.2.3"}

{"actor":"the application","condition":"When the 5GS supports the Paging Policy Differentiation (PPD) feature","normative_type":"unclear","polarity":"unclear","action":"set the DSCP value (TOS in IPv4 / TC in IPv6) to indicate to the 5GS which Paging Policy should be applied for a certain IP packet","exception":""}

{"actor":"the UE","condition":"If the timer T3526 associated with the S-NSSAI(s) was started upon reception of the rejected NSSAI for the maximum number of UEs reached, if the timer T3526 associated with the S-NSSAI(s) expires","normative_type":"permission","polarity":"positive","action":"remove the S-NSSAI(s) from the rejected NSSAI including S-NSSAI(s) with the rejection cause \"S-NSSAI not available due to maximum number of UEs reached\"","exception":""}

{"explanation_ko":"T3526가 최대 UE 수 도달 사유의 rejected NSSAI 수신 시 S-NSSAI(s)와 연관되어 시작되었고, 그 T3526이 만료되면 UE는 해당 S-NSSAI(s)를 rejected NSSAI에서 제거하도록 허용된다. 이때 제거 대상에는 \"S-NSSAI not available due to maximum number of UEs reached\" 거절 사유를 가진 S-NSSAI(s)도 포함된다.","normative_type":"permission","actor":"the UE","condition":"If the timer T3526 associated with the S-NSSAI(s) was started upon reception of the rejected NSSAI for the maximum number of UEs reached, if the timer T3526 associated with the S-NSSAI(s) expires","action":"remove the S-NSSAI(s) from the rejected NSSAI including S-NSSAI(s) with the rejection cause \"S-NSSAI not available due to maximum number of UEs reached\"","exception":"","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 24.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"4.6.1"}

{"actor":"The AMF","condition":"","normative_type":"recommendation","polarity":"positive","action":"set the value of the mobile reachable timer and implicit deregistration timer based on the unavailability period duration and the start of the unavailability period","exception":""}

{"explanation_ko":"AMF는 unavailability period의 지속 시간과 시작 시점을 바탕으로 mobile reachable timer와 implicit deregistration timer의 값을 설정하는 것이 권고된다.","normative_type":"recommendation","actor":"The AMF","condition":"","action":"set the value of the mobile reachable timer and implicit deregistration timer based on the unavailability period duration and the start of the unavailability period","exception":"","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 24.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"5.3.26"}

{"actor":"the 5GS","condition":"when the 5GS acts as a TSN network","normative_type":"capability","polarity":"positive","action":"can act as a sub-network","exception":"which is supported by the 3GPP specifications based on the architecture in clause 4.4.8.2"}

{"explanation_ko":"5GS는 TSN network로 동작하는 경우 sub-network로 작동할 수 있다. 이는 clause 4.4.8.2의 architecture를 기반으로 하는 3GPP specifications에 의해 지원된다.","normative_type":"capability","actor":"the 5GS","condition":"when the 5GS acts as a TSN network","action":"can act as a sub-network","exception":"which is supported by the 3GPP specifications based on the architecture in clause 4.4.8.2","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 23.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"4.4.8.4"}

{"actor":"UE","condition":"If the AMF does not provide the Unavailability configuration IE or the AMF sets the EUPR bit value in the Unavailability configuration IE to \"UE needs to report end of unavailability period\"","normative_type":"recommendation","polarity":"positive","action":"trigger registration procedure for mobility registration update when the unavailability period duration has ended","exception":""}

{"explanation_ko":"AMF가 Unavailability configuration IE를 제공하지 않거나, 해당 IE에서 EUPR 비트를 \"UE needs to report end of unavailability period\"로 설정한 경우, UE는 unavailability period duration이 끝났을 때 mobility registration update를 위한 registration procedure를 트리거하는 것이 권고된다.","normative_type":"recommendation","actor":"UE","condition":"If the AMF does not provide the Unavailability configuration IE or the AMF sets the EUPR bit value in the Unavailability configuration IE to \"UE needs to report end of unavailability period\"","action":"trigger registration procedure for mobility registration update when the unavailability period duration has ended","exception":"","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 24.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"5.3.26"}

{"actor":"the UE operating in dual-registration mode","condition":"when the UE operating in dual-registration mode performs an initial registration procedure","normative_type":"obligation","polarity":"positive","action":"take into use a 5G NAS security context and follow the handling of this security context as described in the present specification","exception":""}

{"explanation_ko":"dual-registration mode로 동작하는 UE가 initial registration procedure를 수행할 때, 반드시 5G NAS security context를 사용하기 시작하고 이 security context의 처리는 본 규격에 설명된 대로 따라야 한다.","normative_type":"obligation","actor":"dual-registration mode로 동작하는 UE","condition":"dual-registration mode로 동작하는 UE가 initial registration procedure를 수행할 때","action":"5G NAS security context를 사용하기 시작하고 이 security context의 처리를 본 규격에 설명된 대로 따른다","exception":"","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 24.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"4.4.2.1.1"}
{"actor":"A new 5G NAS security context","condition":"during an N1 mode to N1 mode handover","normative_type":"permission","polarity":"positive","action":"may also be created","exception":""}

{"explanation_ko":"새로운 5G NAS security context는 N1 mode에서 N1 mode로의 handover 중에도 생성하도록 허용된다. 이는 해당 시점에 생성될 수 있음을 뜻하며, 반드시 생성해야 한다는 의미는 아니다.","normative_type":"permission","actor":"A new 5G NAS security context","condition":"during an N1 mode to N1 mode handover","action":"may also be created","exception":"","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 24.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"4.4.2.1.1"}

{"actor":"UE","condition":"","normative_type":"prohibition","polarity":"negative","action":"use the entering of a Non-Allowed Area as a criterion for Cell Reselection, a trigger for PLMN Selection or Domain selection for UE originating sessions or calls","exception":""}

{"explanation_ko":"UE는 Non-Allowed Area에 진입한 사실을 Cell Reselection의 기준, PLMN Selection의 트리거, 또는 UE originating sessions or calls에 대한 Domain selection의 트리거로 사용해서는 안 된다.","normative_type":"prohibition","actor":"UE","condition":"","action":"Non-Allowed Area에 진입한 사실을 Cell Reselection의 기준, PLMN Selection의 트리거, 또는 UE originating sessions or calls에 대한 Domain selection의 트리거로 사용","exception":"","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 23.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"5.3.4.1.1"}

{"actor":"The 5G NAS security context which is indicated by an ngKSI","condition":"when a new N1 NAS signalling connection is established without executing a new primary authentication and key agreement procedure (see subclause 5.4.1) or when the AMF initiates a security mode control procedure","normative_type":"permission","polarity":"positive","action":"be taken into use to establish the secure exchange of NAS messages","exception":""}

{"explanation_ko":"ngKSI가 가리키는 5G NAS security context는 새 N1 NAS signalling connection이 새 primary authentication and key agreement procedure 없이 설정되거나, AMF가 security mode control procedure를 시작하는 경우에 NAS 메시지의 안전한 교환을 위해 사용하도록 허용된다.","normative_type":"permission","actor":"ngKSI가 가리키는 5G NAS security context","condition":"when a new N1 NAS signalling connection is established without executing a new primary authentication and key agreement procedure (see subclause 5.4.1) or when the AMF initiates a security mode control procedure","action":"be taken into use to establish the secure exchange of NAS messages","exception":"","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 24.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"4.4.2.1.1"}

{"actor":"The configured NSSAI and the rejected NSSAI","condition":"during the registration procedure or the generic UE configuration update procedure","normative_type":"permission","polarity":"positive","action":"may be changed","exception":""}

{"explanation_ko":"configured NSSAI와 rejected NSSAI는 등록 절차 또는 일반 UE 구성 업데이트 절차 동안 변경하도록 허용된다.","normative_type":"permission","actor":"The configured NSSAI and the rejected NSSAI","condition":"during the registration procedure or the generic UE configuration update procedure","action":"may be changed","exception":"","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 24.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"4.6.2.1"}

{"actor":"the UE","condition":"when the UE is required to delete an ngKSI","normative_type":"obligation","polarity":"positive","action":"set the ngKSI to the value \"no key is available\" and consider also the associated keys K AMF or K'AMF, 5G NAS ciphering key and 5G NAS integrity key invalid (i.e. the 5G NAS security context associated with the ngKSI as no longer valid)","exception":""}

{"explanation_ko":"UE는 ngKSI를 삭제해야 하는 경우 ngKSI 값을 \"no key is available\"로 설정해야 하며, 관련된 K AMF 또는 K'AMF, 5G NAS 암호화 키, 5G NAS 무결성 키도 무효로 간주해야 한다. 즉, ngKSI와 연관된 5G NAS 보안 컨텍스트는 더 이상 유효하지 않은 것으로 본다.","normative_type":"obligation","actor":"UE","condition":"UE가 ngKSI를 삭제해야 하는 경우","action":"ngKSI를 \"no key is available\" 값으로 설정하고, 관련 키 K AMF 또는 K'AMF, 5G NAS ciphering key, 5G NAS integrity key를 무효로 간주한다","exception":"","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 24.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"4.4.2.1.1"}

{"actor":"The network","condition":"as long as the selected PLMN/SNPN is available to serve the UE's location","normative_type":"discouragement","polarity":"negative","action":"move the UE to another available PLMN/SNPN, e.g. by handover","exception":""}

{"explanation_ko":"네트워크는 선택된 PLMN/SNPN이 UE의 위치에 서비스를 제공할 수 있는 동안에는 UE를 다른 사용 가능한 PLMN/SNPN으로 이동시키지 않는 것이 권고된다. 예를 들어 핸드오버로 이동시키는 것도 권고되지 않는다.","normative_type":"discouragement","actor":"The network","condition":"as long as the selected PLMN/SNPN is available to serve the UE's location","action":"move the UE to another available PLMN/SNPN, e.g. by handover","exception":"","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 23.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"5.18.4"}

{"actor":"the UE","condition":"to enable an emergency call back; after the completion of the emergency services","normative_type":"recommendation","polarity":"positive","action":"wait for a UE implementation-specific duration of time before requesting the use of MICO mode","exception":""}

{"explanation_ko":"emergency callback을 가능하게 하기 위해, UE는 emergency services 완료 후 MICO mode 사용을 요청하기 전에 UE 구현별 지속 시간 동안 기다리는 것이 권고된다.","normative_type":"recommendation","actor":"UE","condition":"emergency callback을 가능하게 하기 위해; emergency services 완료 후","action":"MICO mode 사용을 요청하기 전에 UE 구현별 지속 시간 동안 기다리기","exception":"","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 24.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"5.3.6"}

{"actor":"The UE","condition":"during the registration procedure","normative_type":"capability","polarity":"positive","action":"provide the SOR transparent container IE to the network in the REGISTRATION COMPLETE message","exception":""}

{"explanation_ko":"UE는 registration procedure 동안 REGISTRATION COMPLETE 메시지에서 SOR transparent container IE를 network에 제공할 수 있다. 이는 기술적으로 가능한 동작을 의미하며, 반드시 해야 하거나 허용만 되는 것으로 표현되지 않는다.","normative_type":"capability","actor":"UE","condition":"during the registration procedure","action":"provide the SOR transparent container IE to the network in the REGISTRATION COMPLETE message","exception":"","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 24.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"4.4.7"}

{"actor":"the SMF","condition":"for a given PDU Session during PDU Session establishment procedure","normative_type":"permission","polarity":"positive","action":"indicate the network instance for the N6 interface (clause 5.6.12) to the UPF","exception":""}

{"explanation_ko":"SMF는 PDU Session establishment procedure 동안 특정 PDU Session에 대해 N6 interface의 network instance를 UPF에 표시하도록 허용된다. 이는 반드시 해야 하는 의무가 아니라 선택적으로 수행할 수 있는 동작이다.","normative_type":"permission","actor":"SMF","condition":"for a given PDU Session during PDU Session establishment procedure","action":"indicate the network instance for the N6 interface (clause 5.6.12) to the UPF","exception":"","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 23.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"4.4.8.3"}

{"actor":"AMF","condition":"To redirect a UE from 5GC to EPC, when the UE sends a Registration Request or Service Request","normative_type":"discouragement","polarity":"negative","action":"send a Registration Reject or Service Reject with an EMM cause value indicating that the UE should not use 5GC","exception":""}

{"explanation_ko":"UE를 5GC에서 EPC로 redirect하기 위해, UE가 Registration Request 또는 Service Request를 보낼 때 AMF는 EMM cause 값으로 UE가 5GC를 사용하지 않아야 함을 나타내는 Registration Reject 또는 Service Reject를 보내는 것이 권고된다.","normative_type":"discouragement","actor":"AMF","condition":"UE가 Registration Request 또는 Service Request를 보낼 때 UE를 5GC에서 EPC로 redirect하기 위해","action":"EMM cause 값으로 UE가 5GC를 사용하지 않아야 함을 나타내는 Registration Reject 또는 Service Reject를 보내는 것","exception":"","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 23.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"5.31.3"}

{"actor":"UDSF implementation and deployment","condition":"If a UDSF is shared between several NFs not part of the same set or is shared between several NF sets","normative_type":"obligation","polarity":"positive","action":"make sure that only NFs that are authorized can access the data","exception":""}

{"explanation_ko":"여러 NF가 같은 set에 속하지 않거나 여러 NF set이 UDSF를 공유하는 경우, UDSF 구현과 배포는 반드시 권한이 있는 NF만 데이터에 접근할 수 있도록 해야 한다.","normative_type":"obligation","actor":"UDSF implementation and deployment","condition":"If a UDSF is shared between several NFs not part of the same set or is shared between several NF sets","action":"make sure that only NFs that are authorized can access the data","exception":"","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 23.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"4.2.5"}

{"actor":"A UE that accesses the 5G Core Network over a non-3GPP access","condition":"after UE registration","normative_type":"obligation","polarity":"positive","action":"support NAS signalling with 5G Core Network control-plane functions using the N1 reference point","exception":""}

{"explanation_ko":"non-3GPP access로 5G Core Network에 접근하는 UE는 UE 등록 후 반드시 N1 reference point를 사용하여 5G Core Network 제어면 기능과 NAS signalling을 지원해야 한다.","normative_type":"obligation","actor":"A UE that accesses the 5G Core Network over a non-3GPP access","condition":"after UE registration","action":"support NAS signalling with 5G Core Network control-plane functions using the N1 reference point","exception":"","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 23.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"4.2.8.1"}

{"actor":"the AMF","condition":"If the UE is authorized to use V2X communication over PC5 reference point based on: a) at least one of the following bits in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message set by the UE, or already stored in the 5GMM context in the AMF during the previous registration procedure as follows: 1) the V2XCEPC5 bit to \"V2X communication over E-UTRA-PC5 supported\"; or 2) the V2XCNPC5 bit to \"V2X communication over NR-PC5 supported\"; and b) the user's subscription context obtained from the UDM as defined in 3GPP TS 23.287 [6C]","normative_type":"discouragement","polarity":"negative","action":"immediately release the NAS signalling connection after the completion of the registration procedure","exception":""}

{"explanation_ko":"AMF는 UE가 PC5 reference point를 통한 V2X communication 사용 권한을 가지고, 그 권한이 REGISTRATION REQUEST의 5GMM capability IE에 UE가 설정한 비트 또는 이전 등록 절차 동안 AMF의 5GMM context에 이미 저장된 비트와 UDM에서 얻은 사용자의 subscription context에 근거하는 경우, 등록 절차 완료 후 NAS signalling connection을 즉시 해제하지 않는 것이 권고된다.","normative_type":"discouragement","actor":"the AMF","condition":"If the UE is authorized to use V2X communication over PC5 reference point based on: a) at least one of the following bits in the 5GMM capability IE of the REGISTRATION REQUEST message set by the UE, or already stored in the 5GMM context in the AMF during the previous registration procedure as follows: 1) the V2XCEPC5 bit to \"V2X communication over E-UTRA-PC5 supported\"; or 2) the V2XCNPC5 bit to \"V2X communication over NR-PC5 supported\"; and b) the user's subscription context obtained from the UDM as defined in 3GPP TS 23.287 [6C]","action":"immediately release the NAS signalling connection after the completion of the registration procedure","exception":"","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 24.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"5.5.1.2.4"}
{"actor":"UE","condition":"In the initial registration procedure, when the key K AUSF is invalid","normative_type":"obligation","polarity":"positive","action":"delete the ngKSI","exception":""}

{"explanation_ko":"초기 등록 절차에서 K_AUSF가 유효하지 않을 때 UE는 ngKSI를 반드시 삭제해야 한다.","normative_type":"obligation","actor":"UE","condition":"In the initial registration procedure, when the key K AUSF is invalid","action":"delete the ngKSI","exception":"","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 24.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"4.4.2.1.1"}

{"actor":"Network functions within the 5GC Control Plane","condition":"","normative_type":"obligation","polarity":"positive","action":"only use service-based interfaces for their interactions","exception":""}

{"explanation_ko":"5GC Control Plane 내부의 Network functions는 상호작용에 대해 서비스 기반 인터페이스만 반드시 사용해야 한다.","normative_type":"obligation","actor":"Network functions within the 5GC Control Plane","condition":"","action":"only use service-based interfaces for their interactions","exception":"","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 23.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"4.2.1"}
{"actor":"The emergency PDU session","condition":"","normative_type":"prohibition","polarity":"negative","action":"be released","exception":""}

{"explanation_ko":"emergency PDU session은 해제되어서는 안 된다. 즉, emergency PDU session의 release는 금지된다.","normative_type":"prohibition","actor":"The emergency PDU session","condition":"","action":"be released","exception":"","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 24.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"4.4.4.3"}

{"actor":"A non-3GPP access network","condition":"","normative_type":"permission","polarity":"positive","action":"advertise the PLMNs or SNPNs for which it supports trusted connectivity and the type of supported trusted connectivity","exception":"e.g. \"5G connectivity\""}

{"explanation_ko":"non-3GPP access network는 trusted connectivity를 지원하는 PLMN 또는 SNPN과, 지원하는 trusted connectivity의 유형을 광고하도록 허용된다. 예를 들어 “5G connectivity”를 광고할 수 있다.","normative_type":"permission","actor":"A non-3GPP access network","condition":"","action":"advertise the PLMNs or SNPNs for which it supports trusted connectivity and the type of supported trusted connectivity","exception":"e.g. \"5G connectivity\"","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 23.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"4.2.8.1"}

{"actor":"UEs that are not subject to 5GS and EPC interworking","condition":"","normative_type":"permission","polarity":"positive","action":"be served by entities not dedicated for interworking, i.e. by either PGW or SMF/UPF","exception":""}

{"explanation_ko":"5GS와 EPC interworking 대상이 아닌 UE는 interworking 전용이 아닌 엔티티에 의해 서비스되도록 허용된다. 즉, PGW 또는 SMF/UPF에 의해 서비스될 수 있다.","normative_type":"permission","actor":"5GS와 EPC interworking 대상이 아닌 UE","condition":"","action":"interworking 전용이 아닌 엔티티에 의해, 즉 PGW 또는 SMF/UPF에 의해 서비스되다","exception":"","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 23.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"4.3.1"}
{"actor":"each SMF","condition":"","normative_type":"capability","polarity":"positive","action":"have the capability to control both a local and a central UPF within a PDU Session","exception":""}

{"explanation_ko":"각 SMF는 하나의 PDU Session 내에서 local UPF와 central UPF를 모두 제어할 기술적 가능성이 있다.","normative_type":"capability","actor":"each SMF","condition":"","action":"control both a local and a central UPF within a PDU Session","exception":"","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 23.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"4.2.3"}

{"actor":"This current 5G NAS security context","condition":"","normative_type":"capability","polarity":"positive","action":"can be of type native or mapped, i.e. originating from a native 5G NAS security context or mapped 5G NAS security context","exception":""}

{"explanation_ko":"AMF는 UE의 요청을 거절하거나 UE를 등록 해제하지 않는 것이 권고된다. 다만 AMF가 UE가 PLMN이 운용할 수 없는 지리적 지역에 위치한다고 판단할 수 있을 만큼 충분히 정확한 UE 위치정보를 가지고 있는 경우에는 이 권고가 적용되지 않는다.","normative_type":"discouragement","actor":"AMF","condition":"","action":"reject the request or deregister the UE","exception":"unless it has sufficiently accurate UE location information to determine that the UE is located in a geographical area where the PLMN is not allowed to operate","citation_spec":"3GPP TS 23.501","citation_version":"18.12.0","citation_clause":"5.4.11.4"}
